meta.name: unit-economics
meta.description: Establishes whether the business makes money on each customer or unit — contribution margin, acquisition cost, payback period, lifetime value, and the cohort behavior underneath. Use this to assess whether growth is profitable, evaluate a channel or segment, support a pricing decision, judge how fast the business can afford to grow, or diagnose why revenue growth is not producing profit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 算清每个客户是否真正赚钱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管业务增长,需要判断每条客户渠道到底赚不赚钱。
copy.tagline_en: See if each customer actually makes you money
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage business growth and need to know which customer channels actually make money.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按固定顺序帮你算单个客户/单笔订单是否赚钱：先定义“单位”，再算贡献毛利、获客成本、回本周期和生命周期价值，并检查数据是否真实、有没有分群看。
howto.when: It triggers when you ask it to assess whether growth is profitable, evaluate a channel or segment, support a pricing decision, judge how fast the business can grow, or diagnose why revenue is not turning into profit.

say.text: 帮我算一下这个 SaaS 的获客成本和回本周期
say.note: 按正文顺序先定义单位，再算贡献毛利、获客成本等

say.text: 分客户群看哪部分人贡献毛利是正的
say.note: 触发它强调分段分析，避免平均掩盖问题

say.text: 这批新客户的留存数据能支持三年生命周期吗
say.note: 会检查你是否把生命周期外推到数据范围之外
